name: Neocitrullamon
summary: Neocitrullamon, also known as amino(diphenylhydantoin) valeric acid is an anticonvulsant.

uses.en: It was studied as an anticonvulsant, that is a drug to control seizures.
uses.zh: 它曾被研究作為抗癲癇藥，也就是用來控制癲癇發作的藥物。
uses.zhHans: 它曾被研究作为抗癫痫药，也就是用来控制癫痫发作的药物。

fact.en: Its structure contains the same hydantoin ring found in phenytoin, the anticonvulsant that was introduced in 1938 and is still widely used.
fact.zh: 它的結構含有與苯妥英相同的乙內醯尿（hydantoin）環，苯妥英是 1938 年問世、至今仍廣泛使用的抗癲癇藥。
fact.zhHans: 它的结构含有与苯妥英相同的乙内酰尿（hydantoin）环，苯妥英是 1938 年问世、至今仍广泛使用的抗癫痫药。
